reviews.title: Generate Lyrics - not really
reviews.text:
I entered this as a lyrics prompt then selected "Generate" to let the app complete the lyrics:
"when the wind blows through my hair
I feel it strip away my cares"

I was very disappointed with the sparse return. Here's what I got back:

[Intro]
Wind wakes the dawn
[Verse 1]
when the wind blows through my hair
I feel it strip away my cares
[Pre-Chorus]
Sky opens wide
[Chorus]
I run free, I run free
[Verse 2]
Sunlight finds my face
[Pre-Chorus]
No weight remains
[Chorus]
I run free, I run free
[Bridge]
Let the blue pull me home
[Chorus]
I run free, I run free
[Outro]
Breathe easy

reviews.title: Repeat Issues, No response from support
reviews.text:
Banger has become incredibly frustrating. It repeatedly ignores instructions, and trying again doesn’t reliably fix the problem. I’ve submitted feedback multiple times and never received a response.

Users deserve a product that follows their directions and support that actually responds. Stop leaving us to figure out what went wrong. Please address these recurring problems and give us a reliable way to correct mistakes.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: App is an absolute scam. OK so the membership fee that you pay is actually just to get you access to the app, you still can’t do anything so you have to pay $32 a month to get access to the app or you could pay $50 a year to get access to the app, red flag right there! Once you’re inside the app you still can’t do anything, you have to buy store credits, but to be able to really create anything with store credits you’re going to have to spend about another $50. So after you spend about $100 on this app, you might get to create one song.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: The app prompts you immediately to get the subscription in order to record your own voice - it was only 99p so sure, for the sake of seeing what the app is about since I’m curious I paid it. I then assumed I’d be able to record my own voice, right? Wrong. So you must not only pay for a subscription, but also £5.99 per voice you wish to record. Not what was advertised, and an absolute scam of an app. Subscription immediately cancelled and refund sent back to my account. I’m not about to pay close to £10 just to trial an app, when there is absolutely no proof that it works, and no way of trialling what it sounds like. It would make more sense if it allowed you to do it, and then said “like what you hear? Pay to save”. Don’t waste your time or money.

reviews.title: Don’t waste your time or money. Hard to cancel subscription
reviews.text:
It’s so confusing. I rarely leave reviews but apps like this really frustrate me because if I pay for a subscription, I would expect that cancelling it would be as easy as signing up for it in the first place.. 

When you try to cancel and go through the steps on the actual app, an alert comes up and, in a nut shell, it says that the App Store is responsible for managing the subscription, which is usually okay and Apple is usually very good at keeping track of which subscriptions you are paying for within their settings, but the app isn’t even listed on there as a paid subscription. I don’t want this to begin charging me $60 for annual membership for this app that isn’t even generating or coming close to the music I am trying to generate. What a joke and shame on you for making cancelling subscriptions difficult to understand. The developers really dropped the ball on this.
